name: Sports extremes maker, trades-source
description: sports-tails' extremes carry (post-only bids on >=90c favourites, offers on <=10c longshots, NBA/NHL game winners, through the game) run on the trades-only backfill source instead of recorded books, so the walk-forward covers Oct 2025-Sep 2026 (game months incl. Oct-Dec 2025) and the 2x-latency run lands on months with games. The strategy code is sports-tails' unchanged.
hypothesis: Same mechanism as sports-tails: takers who buy cheap longshots / sell near-certain favourites pay the 1c tick (5-10% of the price) while the maker fee there is ~0.14c; adverse selection is comebacks. Written before the run: sports-tails' book-source full test gave +1.37c (CI +0.36..+2.36, 1,801 mkts) but could not pass the gate (empty summer months in the latency run, budget used up). An out-of-period trade-print proxy for Oct-Dec 2025 gave +0.8..+1.1c/ct per month (game-clustered se ~1c). Wrong if the pooled walk-forward CI is <= 0, months with games are mostly negative, 2x latency loses, or the lockbox loses. Caveat: the synthetic trades-only book (best bid = last taker sell, ask = last taker buy, depth 50) is a rougher fill model than real books.
next: ad hoc Oct-Dec 2025 first, then smoke/quick/full.
